address: Sopwell House, Cottonmill Lane, St Albans, Herts,AL1 2HQ
bio: Sopwell House is just five minutes from St Albans, an ancient Roman town with a skyline which is dominated by its Cathedral and Abbey as it has done for over 900 years.  Once the country home of Lord Mountbatten, Sopwell House Hotel has the welcoming ambience of a private abode combined with the grandeur of a Georgian manor house set in landscaped gardens.  Take Afternoon Tea in the library, cocktail bar or restaurant which includes a selection of homemade scones, Devonshire clotted cream, strawberry jam, seasonal cakes and finger sandwiches served with a choice of Twining's luxury teas.
